{{Quote|Bohmer was content. The drink you brought him in the morning, the table he sat at-it was his place in the universe.|Ben Kenobi to Annileen Calwell|<ref name="Star Wars: Kenobi" />}}
'''Bohmer''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who was a frequent patron of [[Dannar's Claim]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He drank [[Caf/Legends|caf]] every day and never spoke to [[Annileen Calwell]] or any of the Claim's other patrons. Bohmer was stabbed in the back by a Tusken Raider during [[A'Yark/Legends|A'Yark's]] raid on the Claim. He survived thanks to first aid provided by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]]. [[Mell (Mon Calamari)|Mell]] treated him and brought him to Bestine for treatment. For some time during his recovery, he used a [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|hoverchair]] for mobility. Annileen Calwell constructed a special table that allowed him to comfortably resume his caf habit at the claim while using the chair.
